positions.name: CalibrationVerifiedByReferencePlates
positions.frame: What establishes that the Kestrelwood spectrograph's stated calibration holds — what verification is invoked for the frequency claim?
positions.why: All three expressions assert the same calibration event and ground it in the same evidential act — verification against the June reference plates — whether stated as narrative prose (src-1) or as structured summary fields (src-2, src-3). The directional read is consistent across all three: a flat, unhedged technical claim whose truth condition is the cited verification procedure, not narrative framing. No tension: the bullets restate rather than contest the prose.
